widgetData.source_sentence: query: The two princes Vinda and Anuvinda, both fierce bowmen, for the sake of their friend Duryodhana, rushed upon Virata the ruler of the Matsyas, heedless of their lives and holding their weapons over head.
sentences: passage: Invite them with plenty of seats and welcome them; for they remaining unseated, who is capable of taking his seat?

passage: The Sankhya system, the Aranyaka-Veda, and the Pancharatra scriptures, are all identical and form parts of one whole. This is the religion of those who are devoted whole. mindedly to Narayana—the religion that has Narayana for its Soul.
passage: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौविराटं मस्यमार्च्छताम्। प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा महेष्वासौ मित्रार्थेऽभ्युद्यतायुधौ॥

widgetData.source_sentence: query: यदुक्तं तेन वीरेण राज्ञा काञ्चनवर्मणा। यत् तेऽहमधमाचार दुहित्राऽस्म्यभिवञ्चितः॥
sentences: passage: Which had been communicated by that warrior king, the golden-armored one. As I have been deceived, O you of vile conduct, by you daughter,
passage: All this must be due to my bad fortune, for I have given birth to you. It is for this you have been overtaken by this calamity, notwithstanding your possessing excellent accomplishments.
passage: Seeking in the world (of men), I may light upon a woman like Sītā; but never on a brother, or a helper, or a warrior like to Laksmana.

widgetData.source_sentence: query: Without doubt, O Krishna, a great calamity is at hand, the blood of the Pandavas and the Kurus will be the fierce clay.
sentences: passage: ततस्तं वचनं प्राह ज्येष्ठो धर्मात्मजः प्रभुः। क इज्यते द्विजश्रेष्ठ दैवे पित्र्ये च कल्पिते॥ त्वया मतिमतां श्रेष्ठ तन्मे शंस यथागमम्। किमेतत् क्रियते कर्म फलं वास्य किमिष्यते॥
passage: असंशयमिदं कृष्णं महद् युद्धमुपस्थितम्। पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च घोरं रुधिरकर्दमम्॥
passage: तत् स्थानमनुसम्प्राप्तमन्वपश्यत देवलः। वाजपेयं ऋतुवरं तथा बहुसुवर्णकम्॥

widgetData.source_sentence: query: One should never emaciate himself by abstaining from every enjoyment. Of all births, that of a human being is preferable even if one has to become a Chandala.
sentences: passage: उपभोगैरपि त्यक्तं नात्मानं सादयेन्नरः। चण्डालत्वेऽपि मानुष्यं सर्वथा तात शोभनम्॥

passage: From whose lips shall I this day hear these honeyed words viz. 'That graceful and highsouled king Nala of eyes resembling lotus leaves, the slayer of hostile troops, in quest of whom you are wandering in this forest, is staying even here.'
passage: तच्छ्रुत्वा भरतस्त्रस्तो भ्रातुश्चारित्रशङ्कया। स्वस्य वंशस्य माहात्म्यात् प्रष्टुं समुपचक्रमे॥

widgetData.source_sentence: query: He will certainly accomplish that which is pleasing to you. Surrounding by his brave sons all of whom possess arms like maces. O Brahmana, give me leave to depart, for I have now abandoned all weapons."
sentences: passage: Fearing death in seasons of distress, the Vishvedevas, the Saddhyas, the Brahmanas, and great Rishis, do not hesitate to follow the alternative provisions laid down in the scriptures.
passage: Several Brahrnanas, of really noble souls, acquainted with the Vedas and having nothing lo fear, forbade the king who was boasting too often.
passage: प्रियं च ते सर्वमेतत् करिष्यति न संशयः॥ पुत्रैः परिवृतः सर्वैः शूरैः परिघबाहुभिः। विसर्जयस्व मां ब्रह्मन् न्यस्तशस्त्रोऽस्मि साम्प्रतम्॥
